name: gh
description: GitHub CLI (cli/cli, MIT). The CLI adapter reads only metadata.command at runtime; actual authorization is granted by the server's AGENTHUB_CLI_ALLOWLIST (whole-string EqualFold match). gh is not in the default list and must be added explicitly. A CLI resource has no endpoint, and this example does not declare its own health: it omits both health and metadata.mock_health, so it loads as unknown and is reported degraded after a probe finds no endpoint.

metadata.install: sudo apt install gh (from the official apt repository)
